about: Every model or data file Lumen can download or ships, with its licence. Checked by `npm run licenses` (scripts/licenses.mjs). class: allowed = may be a default; conditional = may be offered with a licence notice in the UI, never as a default; forbidden = must not be referenced by app code; unknown = licence not established yet (warns). `verified: false` marks a classification read from the model card by us, not from the verified licence research. Deny-list entries (delivery: none) exist so the gate catches the model if someone adds it. Runtime code (webR, ruby.wasm, ONNX Runtime, tesseract core) comes from npm and is checked by the npm part of the gate; Pyodide is listed here as well because it is shipped as a data bundle.
